quotes.text: if you run out of work keep picking high value tasks. don't stop and wait for my input.

fields.summary: With milestone 7's chain running one change set at a time, the orchestrator picked three older proposed change sets that touch none of the chain's files, so the daemon's second slot is used: field schemas per node kind, refusing unknown fields on new writes (agents had written made-up fields such as an evidence node's 'observed'); a check warning for constraints linked to nothing; and rhiza why trimming a decision's source quotes to the ones it cites (the founding conversation's quotes made why output 235 lines).
fields.title: Milestone 9: the model keeps itself honest
